Description.SourceString: Whereas the blue dragon hatchlings favour mischief, the red ones only care for blood. They revel in the tearing of flesh and the burning of skin. They unleash their flames on anything that moves, even their siblings who are slower to hatch from the eggs. Of course, for a dragon, this is the same thing as a warm hug, so it’s almost sweet if you think about it.
